# fleet-skills

Skills written in this repo rather than vendored from a package. Today that is `hermes-fleet` — how to operate a three-profile install without breaking one of them.

## Where it is installed

Profiles: `default`, `jason`, `tiferet`

| surface | where it lands | how |
|---|---|---|
| `claude-skill` | `C:\Users\bottl\.claude\skills\hermes-fleet` (claude) | link |
| `skill` | `C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\skills\hermes\hermes-fleet` (default) | copy |
| `skill` | `C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\jason\skills\hermes\hermes-fleet` (jason) | copy |
| `skill` | `C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\tiferet\skills\hermes\hermes-fleet` (tiferet) | copy |

Surface kinds in play:

- **`claude-skill`** — Claude Code skill — installed into ~/.claude/skills, not into Hermes.
- **`skill`** — Skill — a SKILL.md the model reads. Per profile, and paid for on every turn.

## Current state

In sync with `fleet.yaml`.

## Operating it

```bash
fleet status -v                 # includes this package
fleet sync -k fleet-skills      # dry run, this package only
fleet sync -k fleet-skills --apply
```

## Removing it

Take it out of `fleet.yaml`, then:

```bash
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.claude\skills\hermes-fleet'
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\skills\hermes\hermes-fleet'
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\jason\skills\hermes\hermes-fleet'
rm -rf 'C:\Users\bottl\.hermes\profiles\tiferet\skills\hermes\hermes-fleet'
```

> Those targets are links back into this checkout. Removing a link removes
> the link, never the source — but use `rm -rf` on the link itself, not on
> anything *inside* it, or you will delete the real files through it.

## Notes

`skills/claude/` is the source of truth and `skills/hermes/` is GENERATED from it by `fleet port`. Both halves install from this one package, which is the point: edit the Claude side, re-port, sync, and both hosts move together instead of drifting into two different answers to the same question. See skills/PORTING.md.
